Noailles was terrified all the more by the Council of Embrun and by the King's authority in upholding its acts. Many bishops had gathered at Embrun in the year 1727 to overthrow the immense errors that were being scattered everywhere by the schismatics and to settle the disturbances stirred up by them. Furthermore, there were two principal acts: the condemnation of Father Courrayer from the monastery of Saint Genevieve along with his book against the real presence of Christ in the Eucharist, who, intending to execute the system of Dupin , crossed over into England, and raised himself there with other writings concerning the ordinations of Anglican Bishops; and secondly, the sentence brought on September 20th against Soanen , the Bishop of Senez . A certain pastoral Instruction had appeared under his name, teeming with infamous errors of every kind, and in which, as much as the work of Quesnel was commended, so much was the Bull condemning it prostituted as if worthy of every execration.
